preset.text: A team of Robbers is hiding loot at 4 stash spots across the city. The Cops are racing to catch them before the turn timer runs out.
Each Robber gets 4 stash cells (one per corner of the board). Each picks one as their starting cell (revealed). The other 3 are secret. Cops deploy together in the central rectangle.

Each turn, a Robber moves to 1 adjacent cell (any of 8 directions) — or plays a Special Movement card (Getaway Car / Backstreet / Speedboat) for a longer move.

Blue cells on the board represent water, beige cells represent building blocks.

Each Cop moves up to 2 cells (up/down/left/right), then plays either Investigate (probe an adjacent cell for clues) or Bust (try to arrest a Robber).

In a 3-4 player, Cops move like Robbers - to 1 adjacent cell in any direction.

Robbers see live trails on the board — each cell label shows who has visited recently. When a Cop Investigates, that cell's trail is revealed publicly (and updates in real time until the next wipe). Every 10 turns the trails wipe.
Robbers win if ANY Robber places all 4 stash cards. Cops win if every Robber is busted, or if the turn limit (30 / 35 / 40 turns) runs out.
